# Company Memory repository instructions

Read `/AGENTS.md` before making changes. Also read the nearest nested `AGENTS.md`
for the files you edit. Treat those files as the repository's source of truth for
product invariants, ownership, security, validation, and contribution workflow.

Work from one GitHub Issue at a time. State the intended input, output, dependency,
and validation before editing. Do not claim planned features are implemented, do
not expose secrets or real company data, and do not change shared contracts without
coordination recorded in the Issue or pull request.
